unlocks.title: A Pat on the Back
unlocks.desc: The Sindaco remembers your name. New plans: pillar, stairs and raised platform.

unlocks.title: An Extended Permit
unlocks.desc: Your home plot grows, and you can build foundations and roofs.

unlocks.title: Ordinance No. 47, Reconsidered
unlocks.desc: The Sindaco can finally lift Ordinance No. 47 and reopen the lower road.

unlocks.title: A Bust of Your Own
unlocks.desc: The plan for a statue of yourself. The Sindaco asks that it be smaller than his.

unlocks.title: Honorary Citizen
unlocks.desc: A paper crown from the Sindaco's last birthday party. The proper sash is on order.

unlocks.title: Geometra of the Year
unlocks.desc: Every plan in Monteforchetta is yours.
